question: Which mantra formula is likewise placed on the northern part of the head?
premises: A mantra expresses 'may Shiva be mine'.
It is placed on the northern part of the head.
inference: The formula 'śivo me'stu' ending with namah is likewise placed on the northern part of the head.
plain_english: Likewise, place 'śivo me'stu' ending with namah on the northern part of the head.
